system.effect: A successful attack using this weapon that rolls at least 4 dice inflicts 1 additional Wound on each successfully hit target after its other effects resolve. Use the weapon’s Damage domain for this Wound. Temporary Wounds absorb it normally.
system.special: Preserves an additional Wound, not additional Damage. Burned dice do not count. No once-per-turn cap. Applying this to every hit target is an explicit draft interpretation; high-priority playtest.
system.flavor: A large commitment converts directly into additional injury.
